# Weather Guard Coating

> Weather Guard Coating is a professional painting contractor based in London, Ontario, Canada, serving Southwestern Ontario since 1989. We provide residential, interior, commercial, farm & agricultural, and roof coating services, plus grain bin base sealing, backed by 35+ years of experience, full WSIB and liability insurance, and a written workmanship warranty.

Weather Guard Coating is fully insured, uses Sherwin-Williams and Benjamin Moore paint products exclusively, and offers free, no-obligation written estimates. The business is located at 611 Wonderland Rd N, Unit 225, London, Ontario N6H 5N7, and can be reached at (226) 448-1189 or WeatherGuardcoating@gmail.com.

## Services

- [Residential Painting](https://weatherguardcoating.ca/services/residential-painting): Interior and exterior home painting.
- [Interior Painting](https://weatherguardcoating.ca/services/interior-painting): Clean, precise interior painting for homes and businesses.
- [Commercial Painting](https://weatherguardcoating.ca/services/commercial-painting): Painting for offices, retail, and commercial buildings with flexible scheduling to minimize business disruption.
- [Farm & Agricultural Painting](https://weatherguardcoating.ca/services/farm-painting): Durable coatings for barns, silos, and farm structures.
- [Custom Barn & Farm Painting](https://weatherguardcoating.ca/services/custom-barn-farm-painting): Custom-specified coating systems for barns and outbuildings.
- [Roof Coating](https://weatherguardcoating.ca/services/roof-coating): Elastomeric and reflective coatings for flat and low-slope roofs.
- [Grain Bin Base Sealing](https://weatherguardcoating.ca/services/grain-bin-base-sealing): Base sealing for grain bins to keep out moisture and pests.

## Service area

London, Ontario and surrounding Southwestern Ontario communities including Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge, Stratford, St. Thomas, Woodstock, Strathroy, Sarnia, Tillsonburg, Ingersoll, Aylmer, Brantford, and Goderich (approximately 160km radius from London).
